chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:

O group of traders, protect your wealth through charity; your sins will be expiated from you, and the oaths which you swear therein will be purified for you; your trade will be made wholesome for you.

key_terms.بِالصَّدَقَةِ: through charity given for the sake of Allah

ai.seo_question: How does charity protect wealth and purify trade in Islam?
ai.summary: The Imam عليه السلام instructs traders to safeguard their wealth by giving charity. He teaches that charity brings expiation of sins and purification of the oaths commonly associated with trade, leading to wholesomeness and blessing in one’s commerce.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "O group of traders, protect your wealth through charity, your sins will be forgiven, and the oaths you make will be purified for you-thus your trade will be blessed."
